body:
I have now locked my account so that my brother cannot access it. I am very sorry for the inconvenience and it will not happen again. Thanks.
Banned for racial slurs.
I am aware this has happened more than once but I didn't realise after logging in for the first time today.
please reconsider kind regards RandomGuyWasHere--Josh
